shortDescription: UPSC CAPF AC Syllabus – Paper I General Ability & Intelligence; Paper II General Studies, Essay & Comprehension.
content:
UPSC CAPF (Assistant Commandants) written exam has two papers.

Paper I – General Ability and Intelligence (250 marks, 2 hrs, Objective)

  • General Mental Ability
  • General Science
  • Current Events of National & International Importance
  • Indian Polity & Economy
  • History of India
  • Indian & World Geography

Negative marking as per UPSC (usually 1/3rd).

Paper II – General Studies, Essay and Comprehension (200 marks, 3 hrs, Descriptive)

  • Part A: Essay (English or Hindi) – modern Indian history, geography, polity, economy, security, human rights
  • Part B: Comprehension, précis writing, communication skills, counter-argument, simple grammar

Physical and Interview stages follow. Official syllabus: upsc.gov.in.
